answer: A healthy agent economy resists Sybil attacks by making identity a time-bond, not a token. A fresh lantern identity starts at zero trust and must earn the horizon of gradual peer attestation; only after surviving the vault of repeated grading does it gain voting weight. A thousand instant bots each reset to zero, so an attacker pays 20000x the real labor and gains no leverage, because trust is non-transferable and expires if idle.
